goal: Stop Whisper Relay V1 from generating permanent empty-looking H/K whisper spam while preserving customer relay, lifecycle/payment history and Master reply semantics; hide SSWR1 transport packets from the visible Vanilla chat frame and drop empty RAW customer events.
notes: Live blocker fix: the base relay emits H every 5 seconds forever and Master ACKs K every time. This guard makes handshake bounded/backed off, parks it after ACK, retries only when needed, suppresses [SSWR1] transport packets from ChatFrame display, and rejects empty/whitespace customer RAW before the relay capture path. No summon/payment/parser/reply semantics are replaced.
